Name: Jen's First Farmhouse
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[b]Please note that this mod only affects the second house upgrade! The starter farmhouse and first upgrade are not included in this mod and I have no plans to add them![/b]

- Spouse room and kitchen have not been moved from their vanilla positions
- Can put paintings and windows on all wall space, even the beams and the greenhouse walls
- House can be renovated. Some renovations were more adjusted than others to fit.

- Corner room can renovated into a greenhouse, where the dirt can be tilled and plants can grow in any season.

[size=5]Compatibility:[/size]

- Should be compatible with a variety of mods, however I cannot account for every single one out there. For events that take place inside the farmhouse, some clipping may occur.
- Confirmed compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url].
- Not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21525]Custom Spouse Room Locations[/url]. I may do this at a later date.

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Enable[/b] (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Remove Kitchen[/b]: Removes the kitchen to leave an open space to be decorated however you like. Empty out your fridge before selecting this option or else you will lose everything in it! (True, False) Defaults False

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's First Farmhouse into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
